report:
Asking About Monitoring in debezium

Hello, im new using this tools. I'm using this tutorial https://github.com/debezium/debezium-examples/tree/main/monitoring but change it into mysql, the issue i have is the rows scanned is not changed, even though i already add some data in my database. Could you help me whats wrong with my set up?
Thank you

evidence.quote: The \"RowsScanned\" metric is only applicable for the snapshot phase of the connector, so once the snapshot has finished... you won't see that table update anymore

notes: RowsScanned not changing after inserts is intended: it is a snapshot-only metric; streaming metrics (TotalNumberOf*) should be used.
